---
title: "Patch supplementary figures — boxplots and ANOVA heatmap"
---

## Overview

Compose individual VAE and UMAP boxplots into multi-panel supplementary figures. Loads pre-generated ggplot2 RDS objects from the lite pipelines, applies consistent theming, and saves high-resolution PNGs.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Helper functions

### Fix p-value labels

Replace `%*%` (dot product) with `times` (multiplication sign) in plotmath labels stored in geom_text layer data.

```{r}
#| label: fix-pvalue-labels

fix_pvalue_labels <- function(p) {
  # %*% already renders correctly as x (multiplication sign) in plotmath.
  # This function is kept as a pass-through in case future label fixes are needed.
  p
}
```

### Shift p-value text position

Move p-value annotations leftward so they don't get clipped at publication width.

```{r}
#| label: shift-pvalue-text

shift_pvalue_text <- function(p, x = 0.06) {
  for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
    ap <- p$layers[[i]]$aes_params
    if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomText") &&
        identical(ap$colour, "darkred")) {
      p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$x <- I(x)
    }
  }
  p
}
```

### Rescale patchwork sub-plots

Apply `rescale_layer_params()` to a patchwork object by iterating over all sub-plots.

```{r}
#| label: rescale-patchwork

rescale_patchwork <- function(pw, ...) {
  pw <- rescale_layer_params(pw, ...)
  if (!is.null(pw$patches$plots)) {
    for (i in seq_along(pw$patches$plots)) {
      pw$patches$plots[[i]] <- rescale_layer_params(pw$patches$plots[[i]], ...)
    }
  }
  pw
}
```

### Compose boxplot panels

```{r}
#| label: patch-boxplot

patch_boxplot <- function(p, remove_x_title = FALSE) {
  p <- fix_pvalue_labels(p)
  p <- p + theme_main_fig() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 2, r = 2)
    )
  p <- rescale_layer_params(p, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)
  p <- shift_pvalue_text(p)
  if (remove_x_title) {
    p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  }
  p
}
```

## Load boxplot data

Load boxplot lists from the lite pipelines for both VAE and UMAP.

```{r}
#| label: load-boxplots

vae_boxplot_7 <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/latent_coordinates/output/fig_tbl/boxplot_list_threshold_7.rds")
)

umap_boxplot_8 <- read_rds(
  here("UMAP/lite/latent_coordinates/output/fig_tbl/boxplot_list_threshold_8.rds")
)

umap_boxplot_7 <- read_rds(
  here("UMAP/lite/latent_coordinates/output/fig_tbl/boxplot_list_threshold_7.rds")
)
```

## Supplementary figures: Boxplots

### VAE boxplot threshold 7 (prev + stable_mci)

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-vae-boxplot-t7

fs::dir_create(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"))
fig_vae_boxplot_t7 <- wrap_plots(
  patch_boxplot(vae_boxplot_7[["prev"]], remove_x_title = TRUE),
  patch_boxplot(vae_boxplot_7[["stable_mci"]]),
  ncol = 1
) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_vae_boxplot_threshold7.png"),
       fig_vae_boxplot_t7,
       width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

### VAE one_dim_selected threshold 7

Single faceted plot -- no patchwork tags needed. Keep only the dimensions reaching ANOVA significance
(*P* < 0.01). Derive them from the plot's own p-value layer, never from a hardcoded dimension list --
the `vae_N` indices are not stable across fits, and a hardcoded subset silently drops panels on a
retrain instead of failing.

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-vae-boxplot-one-dim-t7

p_base <- vae_boxplot_7[["one_dim_selected_1row"]]

# The ANOVA p-values are baked into the geom_text layer; find it by class, not index.
label_idx <- purrr::detect_index(p_base$layers, \(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomText"))
stopifnot(label_idx > 0)

keep_dims <- p_base$layers[[label_idx]]$data |>
  dplyr::filter(p < 0.01) |>
  dplyr::pull(vae_dir) |>
  as.character()

# Fail loudly if a retrain rotates the latent basis, rather than silently changing the figure.
stopifnot(
  "Supp Fig 11 caption names VAE_1/VAE_2; the significant THR7 dimensions have changed" =
    setequal(keep_dims, c("vae_1", "vae_2"))
)

p_base$data <- p_base$data |> dplyr::filter(vae_dir %in% keep_dims) |> droplevels()
for (i in seq_along(p_base$layers)) {
  ld <- p_base$layers[[i]]$data
  if (!is.null(ld) && "vae_dir" %in% names(ld)) {
    p_base$layers[[i]]$data <- ld |> dplyr::filter(vae_dir %in% keep_dims) |> droplevels()
  }
}

fig_vae_boxplot_one_dim_t7 <- fix_pvalue_labels(p_base) +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 2, r = 2)
  )
fig_vae_boxplot_one_dim_t7 <- rescale_layer_params(fig_vae_boxplot_one_dim_t7, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)
fig_vae_boxplot_one_dim_t7 <- shift_pvalue_text(fig_vae_boxplot_one_dim_t7)

ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_vae_boxplot_one_dim_threshold7.png"),
       fig_vae_boxplot_one_dim_t7,
       width = 4.2, height = 3.0, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

fig_anova_heatmap <- read_rds(

fig_anova_heatmap <- fig_anova_heatmap +

  theme(

fig_anova_heatmap <- rescale_layer_params(fig_anova_heatmap, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)

## VAE methodology (architecture + CV illustration)

Adapted from `VAE_graph/03_patch_vae_figures.qmd`. Combines the VAE architecture schematic (panel a) with the 5-fold CV illustration (panel b).

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-vae-methodology

panel_a <- read_rds(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_architecture_pub.rds"))
panel_b <- read_rds(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_cv_pub.rds"))

panel_a <- rescale_patchwork(panel_a, size_scale = 0.55, linewidth_scale = 0.55)
panel_b <- rescale_layer_params(panel_b, size_scale = 0.55, linewidth_scale = 0.55)
panel_b <- panel_b +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)))

fig_vae_methodology <- wrap_elements(panel_a) / panel_b +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))

ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_vae_methodology.png"),
       fig_vae_methodology,
       width = 6.5, height = 7.6, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*suppl_vae_boxplot*|*suppl_umap_boxplot*|*suppl_anova*|*suppl_vae_methodology*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
